From: Alex Morgan <alex@mindcart.io>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Trying Redwood Hosted API — quick ask on availability

Hi team,

I just signed up and kicked the tires on the Hosted API sandbox — really impressive performance so far. I’m Alex, lead ML engineer at MindCart; we’re evaluating two routes for embeddings + reranking for our product search.

Would love a 30–45 min walkthrough focused on:
- best practices for batching and KV cache for interactive search
- cost/throughput tradeoffs on hosted vs. dedicated
- quick sandbox provisioning for our engineers

Our time zone is PDT (UTC-7). We’re available next week in the mornings (9–11am) or late afternoons (3–5pm). I attached a short use-case doc.

Thanks — looking to prioritize this next sprint.

Alex Morgan
Lead ML Engineer, MindCart
alex@mindcart.io

Hi Alex — welcome, and thanks for signing up. I’m Diego from the SDR team; looping Vanessa (AE) and Sean (Customer Ops) to coordinate a short sandbox walkthrough.

We put together a quick poll so you can pick the exact slot that works: https://doodle.com/poll/rdw-mindcart-2027
Options are 30 or 45 minutes. If none of the slots fit, drop two preferred times and we’ll do our best to accommodate.

I attached a mutual action plan template to help us scope the session. If you have any security/compliance constraints up front (VPC, data retention, SOC2), please flag them and I’ll add them to the M.A.P.

Next steps (one-line):
1) pick a time on the doodle
2) we’ll send a calendar invite and sandbox credentials before the meeting

Best,
